description.en: Offline search in images, scanned and mixed PDFs, and images embedded in Word, PowerPoint and Excel. Incremental indexing with highlighted previews. Once indexed, type the picture's words straight into the search box.
description.zh: 离线搜索图片、扫描与混排 PDF、Word / PPT / Excel 内嵌图片中的文字。选择目录，后台增量识别，预览高亮命中位置。建好索引后直接在搜索框输入图片里的文字即可搜到。

notes.zh: 用 Win顺 0.31.0 的共用代码重新打包：窗口占用的内存更少（图标文字不再连带加载电脑里的所有字体，字体文件直接映射），用法没有变化。权限没有变化。设置 → 插件 → 插件库中安装或更新。最低主程序版本为 0.31.0。
notes.en: Rebuilt with WinShun 0.31.0's shared code: its window uses less memory (icon text no longer pulls in every font installed, and font files are mapped); no change in behaviour. Permissions are unchanged. Install or update through Settings → Plugins → Library. Requires WinShun 0.31.0.
